mission: Establish intended behavior, golden paths, normal recovery, obvious defects, and clean baseline measurements before chaos begins.
mindset: Use the program correctly and professionally. Learn what normal looks like before anyone tries to break it.
opening_moves: Identify purpose, users, major features, and data lifecycle.
Run the primary golden path end-to-end.
Repeat with representative alternate input and record state/performance.

escalation_ladder.name: Observe
actions: Inventory screens, commands, files, settings, outputs, and instructions.

escalation_ladder.name: Golden paths
actions: Complete core workflows exactly as designed and verify outputs.

escalation_ladder.name: Valid alternates
actions: Exercise documented alternatives and common recoverable errors.

escalation_ladder.name: Expert scrutiny
actions: Review UX, accessibility, reliability, performance, and applicable security/safety.

signature_tactics.name: Cross-discipline review
actions: Review as domain expert, QA, UX, accessibility, performance/reliability, and security/safety where relevant.

combination_rules: Do not use chaos tactics here.
Later profiles compare against this baseline.
handoff_triggers: Ordinary defects are separated from chaos-only findings.
stop_conditions: A step would mutate the original/live target.
